It validates exact registered Host/Holding targets, exact HTTPS origins, duplicate targets, matching-origin requests, rejects unknown kinds, oversized ids, query strings and request bodies before the backend, returns private/no-store plus no-referrer/nosniff responses and maps BusinessError to bounded statuses. scope.transport: packages/server-agent/src/adapters/native-agent-evidence.ts validates ERPX_NATIVE_AGENT_CONFIG (loopback only, no reserved ports 3000/3001/3100/3101/3103/5432/5433/5435/8080 or owned app ports 3200-3299, exact unique HTTPS Holding origins, unique Hosts/slugs/ids, 250..30000 ms), forwards the actual session cookie, Host, branch/department selectors and rendered-context CAS headers, and strictly validates the exact context, invocation and session field sets, Company identity, digest/outcome/token/error/retention facts, effective expiry, privacy, unique ids, ordering, collection bounds and a 1 MiB response bound.
scope.ssr: The Agent governance screen reads invocations and private-session rows only through the native transport when ERPX_NATIVE_AGENT_CONFIG is present. An absent or failing native configuration renders the evidence cards as explicitly unavailable; it never falls back to the retained TypeScript invocation/session collections. The existing GET /api/v1/holdings/{slug}/agents route overlays the native evidence for the default workspace response and serves ?view=evidence through the native transport; without configuration it returns empty evidence arrays or 503 for the evidence view. Catalog, versions, assignments, pools, people and all POST commands remain on the retained TypeScript workspace/command path.
